label: Core
description: Core steps the engine runs itself: triggers, AI, HTTP, data shaping, control flow and human approval.

nodes.label: Manual trigger
nodes.description: Start the workflow on demand; seeds the run input downstream.
nodes.search: start manual run on demand trigger begin

nodes.label: Schedule trigger
nodes.description: Run on a cron schedule (e.g. every weekday at 9am).
nodes.search: schedule cron daily hourly recurring timer trigger

nodes.label: AI agent
nodes.description: Reason over upstream outputs with a large language model. The workhorse for research, synthesis, extraction, transformation and summarization.
nodes.search: ai llm agent reason summarize synthesize extract classify write analyze transform parse

nodes.label: HTTP request
nodes.description: Call any public URL. Carries no stored credentials; imported API nodes do.
nodes.search: http api rest get post fetch request call url json rss feed

nodes.label: Transform data
nodes.description: Reshape, filter, sort, group or total data with a jq expression. Exact and free: use this instead of agent.llm whenever the change can be stated as a rule. The expression's input is an object with .input, .outputs.<dependency key>.<field>, and inside a loop .item.
nodes.search: transform map filter select sort group sum count reshape extract jq json data pick fields dedupe merge

config.label: jq expression
config.help: jq syntax, not a {{template}}. Read upstream data as .outputs.<dependency key>.<field>. Wrap in [ ] to return a list.

nodes.label: If / Else
nodes.description: Gate: evaluate a condition; when false, the entire downstream subgraph is skipped.
nodes.search: if else branch condition gate compare decide

config.label: Condition
config.help: A comparison (== != > < >= <= contains), or several joined with && and ||, with ! and parentheses. Example: outputs.fetch.status == 200 && outputs.fetch.body.total > 100

nodes.label: Filter
nodes.description: Gate: pass the flow through only when the condition holds; otherwise skip downstream.
nodes.search: filter condition keep when rule gate

config.label: Keep when
config.help: A comparison (== != > < >= <= contains), or several joined with && and ||, with ! and parentheses. Example: outputs.fetch.status == 200 && outputs.fetch.body.total > 100

nodes.label: Loop
nodes.description: Fan out: resolve a list and run the downstream branch once per item, one item at a time. Inside the body, {{item}} is the current element and {{loop.<key>.index}} its position. Afterwards outputs.<key>.results holds one entry per item, and succeeded/failed count them. A loop cannot contain another loop.
nodes.search: loop foreach iterate items map fan out each repeat

config.label: When an item fails
config.help: stop (default) fails the run at the first failed item. continue records the failure in results and errors, and carries on with the next item.

nodes.label: Wait
nodes.description: Pause the run, then continue. The pause survives restarts. Give seconds, or until as a time.
nodes.search: wait delay sleep pause later timer until hold

config.label: Seconds
config.help: How long to pause, at most 30 days (2592000).

config.label: Until
config.help: A time to wait for, instead of seconds. Supports {{input.x}}.

nodes.label: Human approval
nodes.description: Pause the run until a person approves. If rejected, everything downstream is skipped.
nodes.search: approval review human confirm sign off pause gate
